limitations: This is source/patch accountability and static identity verification only. No application process, compilation, linking, native run, sanitizer run, shared lease, publication or acceptance was performed by this reviewer. Parent must attach actual exact-stage evidence separately.

The live-source read is an unlocked timestamped observation, not an atomic freeze. Live DnD work can progress independently. Only sealed stages and exact patch pre/postimages define the proposed change; never copy a whole staged file over a newer live file.

Cancellation is per in-flight transfer. Earlier completed moves stay completed, later selected objects with newer admissions remain untouched; there is no all-or-nothing transaction or deleted-destination resurrection policy.

Newer source intent means a native STRONG-container add observed during the synchronous dispatch. Weak membership does not cancel. A NULL parent or object reference count is not root-ownership evidence.

Admission records are monotonic even after an observer removes that new membership. Remove-only and reorder-only callbacks are outside this mechanism, including an insertion-side source deletion with no newer strong add.

GimpContainer permits multiple memberships. The repair prevents adding the obsolete requested move after a recorded newer admission; it does not undo duplicate ownership directly created by an observer.

Fixtures use ordinary unsorted, non-unique-name ToolGroup child lists. Arbitrary RUN_FIRST subclass callbacks, custom comparators and unique-name reentry can act before hook observation and are not proven safe by these cases.
Cross-thread native UI-model mutation is unsupported. Ignoring other-thread hook invocations and heap-safe hook data is not a concurrency correctness claim.

Native vfunc/model tests do not cover physical drag transport, hit testing, event delivery, tablet behavior, arbitrary cycles, external mutation of caller nodes or a changed drag success API. The generic drop vfunc remains void and transport/caller prefix stays unchanged.

Original image-specific layer group MOVE/Undo and cross-image COPY bodies remain controls. Multi-tool tests and foreign-type COPY admission do not accept derived conversion, selector, provider, alternate-action, orientation or other sibling behavior.

All fourteen relocation wrappers run four positions only after preceding positions return. In particular relocate_on_insert_valid starts BEFORE and is red on six-stage production, while AFTER can pass; no four-independent-baseline-red claim is valid.

Owner-loss raw failures need causal diagnosis separately after order/topology repair. A generic crash, invalid-type warning, or original-head topology assertion is insufficient. No fatal policy or sanitizer diagnostic suppression is authorized.

Original five and prior fifteen include bytes and refcount assertions are preserved. The inherited opening singleton-only comment describes the original fragment; appended tests explicitly identify modern generic multi-item scope.

All 93 original 08.017 duties and 140/661 original completion remain unchanged. DnD evidence cannot close 29.010/standard-tool-options,29.020 or any source-specific siblings. Windows link, GIR, physical UI and broader feature acceptance remain separate.
